panels.description: Wide, full page width. A fort courtyard of laterite walls and tiled roofs under a bruised sky, a grey squall line charging in from the sea over the far wall. Men drag oiled cloth over powder barrels. A plan board lies abandoned in the mud, spotted with rain, the only sign of the storehouse meeting. In the foreground, turning from the rain, Nagoji (ch21 look: Kerala topknot, no turban, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain of office across his chest, first grey at the temples, the Goa brand on his left wrist; no knife, no bandages, no coat).

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: I had always known that Ramayyan wrote things down.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: What I had not seen, until that afternoon, was the scale of his book.

panels.description: Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) ducking through a low doorway in an inner wall, one hand holding a loose fold of shoulder cloth over his head like a rain hood, the bump of the topknot visible beneath, the cloth not wrapped or tied. Rain sheets off the eaves behind him. Darkness ahead.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: I found it by accident.

panels.description: Large, half the page. The room, seen from the doorway. Wooden shelves from floor to ceiling, packed with palm-leaf bundles, each tied with string and hung with a small clay tag bearing abstract impressed marks, no script. The rows recede into shadow. The floor is swept and the shelves are free of dust. Grey light falls from a single high, narrow window. A small coconut-oil lamp burns on a low table in the centre. At the table, cross-legged, Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain, stylus in hand). He looks up. He is not startled.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: You found my garden.

panels.description: Two-shot. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) in the near foreground at frame left, just inside the door, rainwater running from his hair and cloth, a small pool forming on the swept floor. Beyond him at frame right, Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) still seated at the low table, lifting one ink-stained hand toward the shelves, the way a man shows a guest his trees.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: Garden?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: These are the plants I tend.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Some bear fruit. Some only thorns.

panels.description: Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) moving between the shelves, turned sideways so he does not brush the bundles. Close in the foreground, a row of clay tags with abstract impressed marks, no script, swinging slightly on their strings.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: What are they?

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: I had already guessed.

panels.description: Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) seated at frame right, untying a bundle with the ease of long habit, the string coming loose in one pull. He does not look at his hands.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Records. Of land. Of grain. Of taxes. Of temple offerings. Of letters.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Of men.

panels.description: Insert, tight, hands only, no faces. The top leaf of the bundle, lamp-lit, held flat and square to camera and filling the width of the frame, with exactly four empty horizontal bands and no marks. Ramayyan's ink-stained fingertip rests in the left margin beside the first band, not over it.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Sawant, Nagoji.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Origin: Deccan, near Nashik.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: First appearance: Goan dungeon, retrieved by Travancore allies.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Family: father (farmer), mother, younger brother.

panels.description: The same leaf, same framing, hands only, no faces. The frame has slid down to the leaf's last two empty bands. The fingertip has moved down the left margin and rests beside the lower band.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Loyalties: to Maratha ideal, to personal honour, increasingly to Travancore king.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Risks: potential Maratha recall, emotional ties northward, relationship with Revathi Bayi (alliance tied, marriage).

panels.description: Two-shot. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) standing at frame left, mid-cough, fist at his mouth. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) seated at frame right, calm, the leaf still open in his lap.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: You write this of me?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: I would be negligent if I did not. You are a piece on the board.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Pieces can be lost in many ways. I keep track.

panels.description: Insert, hands only. The next leaf, flat and square to camera, filling the width of the frame, with exactly two empty horizontal bands and no marks. Ramayyan's ink-stained fingers rest at its right edge, ready to turn it. Bleeding in at the panel's left edge like a stain, not a clean frame: Padmini Amma on her verandah, thick black hair coiled at the nape, cotton sari hitched for walking, long walking stick planted beside her. No other figure.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Padmini Amma. Landholdings. Kin ties. Temper.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Heir: Nandini, a niece.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: Years later he would add, in the same neat hand, the date of Padmini's death beside it.

panels.description: The next leaf, same framing, hands only: flat and square to camera, exactly two empty horizontal bands, a fingertip in the left margin. Ghosted at the panel's right edge the same way: Revathi Bayi in an indigo sari with gold, jasmine in her braid, a tali at her throat, the first grey threading her hair.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Revathi Bayi. Velinadu rights. Alliances. Known grudges.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Eight Houses of the Marches. Broken formally, roots remain.

panels.description: Insert. No figure, no face; only the leaf and Ramayyan's hand. A leaf lying flat on the table, square to camera and filling the width of the frame, with exactly three empty horizontal bands and no marks. The lamp rakes across it from one side. Ramayyan's hand rests still at its left edge. No ghosted face this time.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Elayadathu Swaroopam (Kottarakkara).

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Senior lady: Savitri. Disposition: hostile.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Dutch contact: confirmed. Letters intercepted: three.

panels.description: Extreme close on the same leaf, flat and square to camera. No figure, no face; only the leaf and Ramayyan's hand. Exactly two empty horizontal bands. Ramayyan's fingertip rests in the left margin beside the upper band, the Velinadu connection line, and stays there a beat too long. Two short ink strokes run under the right-hand third of the lower band only.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Velinadu connection: blood tie to Revathi Bayi. Leverage: significant.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Risk assessment: HIGH. Timeline: before next monsoon.

panels.description: Nagoji's face, close (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat), his eyes still on the leaf as Ramayyan's ink-stained hand lays it face down on the table at the bottom of the frame.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: He did not explain. I did not ask.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: Some ledgers are not meant to be read aloud.

panels.description: Ramayyan's ink-stained finger tapping another leaf, deflecting. The leaf is flat and square to camera, with exactly one empty horizontal band and no marks, and his fingertip rests in the left margin beside it. Ghosted at the panel's edge: Eustachius De Lannoy, tall, pale hair tied back, a plain cotton coat over a European shirt, white mundu, not a uniform, holding a folded letter to a candle flame. Leave room for a balloon above the leaf.

copy.speaker: LEAF
copy.text: Lannoy. Family in Europe. Letters sent and burned. Possible breaking points.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN (off)
copy.text: He worries about his soul. That is useful to know.

panels.description: Two-shot. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) at frame left, caught between amusement and discomfort, half a smile that does not reach his eyes. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right, rising from the low table to his feet.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: And you keep such lists on everyone? Even the king?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Especially the king. He understands that forgetting is a luxury small kingdoms cannot afford.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: You watch us all.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Yes.

panels.description: Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) alone at frame right, standing, one hand resting on a far shelf of bundles whose clay tags carry the same abstract impressed marks, no script. A little sad around the mouth. The other man is off-panel at frame left.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI (off)
copy.text: Is that not... exhausting?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: It is what I know how to do. You count men and hooves. I count tendencies.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Between us, perhaps we keep this place alive.

panels.description: Wide, the tallest panel on the page. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right draws a single bundle from a low shelf at his own knee and lifts its wooden cover board toward Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) at frame left. **Inset, lower right:** the bundle's top leaf fully exposed, flat and square to camera, with exactly two empty horizontal bands and no marks. The cover board is already swinging down at the inset's top edge, Ramayyan's thumb on it, and its shadow is starting across the leaf's top margin above the bands.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: You write of my loyalties. Do you write of your own?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Of course. Only not where anyone else can read.

copy.speaker: LEAF (in the inset)
copy.text: Ramayyan. Loyalties: to the idea of a Travancore that outlives this generation.

copy.speaker: LEAF (in the inset)
copy.text: To the king as long as he remembers that.

panels.description: Wide two-shot. The two men standing among the shelves, rain murmuring at the high window, the lamp flame steady. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) at frame left, not looking at him. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right, composed, hands folded.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: Does it not feel like spying? Keeping such close watch on men who trust you?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Spying is what others call watching when they disapprove of the watchers.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: I call it preparation. Goodwill is a poor shield. Knowledge is better.

panels.description: Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) turning to face him, hard.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: Knowledge can twist. It can make you cut men down before they have done anything, because you fear they might.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN (off)
copy.text: You speak like someone who has seen that happen.

panels.description: Full width, bleeding in like a stain. Pune, years earlier. The narrator is not in frame; this is his point of view. Behind a carved wooden screen, a Maratha sardar in a Maratha pagadi turban, a silk angarkha and strings of pearls, one ringed hand raised in judgement. Beside him a Brahmin astrologer in a dhoti and an uparna, holding a horoscope leaf marked only with a blank square kundali grid of ruled lines, no numerals or script (do not use the V13 temple priest face). In the foreground a loyal cavalry captain on his knees, head bowed, his sword still sheathed at his hip: an older Maratha rider with a full, grey-flecked beard and a saffron pagadi. Cut before any stroke: only an executioner's shadow falls across him.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI (off, from the archive)
copy.text: In Pune, I watched a sardar order a loyal captain executed because a Brahmin said the stars looked wrong.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI (off)
copy.text: He had heard a rumour that the captain admired another chief. That rumour became fact in his mind because fear and jealousy filled the gaps.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI (off)
copy.text: The supposed traitor never even drew his sword.

panels.description: Back in the room. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right, nodding slowly, his eyes on the shelves rather than on the other man.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Fear is my enemy too. That is why I write.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: It gives fear less room to invent.

panels.description: Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right, one palm laid against a shelf of bundles. Bleeding in at the right-hand edge behind him, in the same stain style as 4.2: Revathi Bayi (indigo sari with gold, jasmine in her braid, a tali, first grey in her hair), one hand raised palm-out, turning away a sealed letter held out to her from beyond the frame by a hand in a dark European cuff. Ramayyan's eyes have lifted from the shelves to Nagoji, off-panel at frame left, and his gaze is sharpening.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: When a chief whispers that Revathi plots against the king, I can see that she has refused three offers from Dutch factors in the last month.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: I do not have to guess.

panels.description: Two-shot across the low table, the lamp flame between them. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) back at his table at frame right, leaning forward over it. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) crouched across the table from him at frame left.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: You fear that one day you will open a letter from your brother, and I will be reading over your shoulder.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: Should I not?

panels.description: Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) retying the bundle that holds Nagoji's name, knotting the string without looking.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: If I decide to keep you from riding north, it will not be because of a letter.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: It will be because the balance of this kingdom requires it.

panels.description: Wide, high angle. Ramayyan (thin face, receding hairline, plain white cloth, no chain) at frame right, on his feet, sliding the bundle back into its slot on a wall of hundreds of identical bundles. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) at frame left, small beside the table below. The shelves dwarf them both.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: If I decide it is better to let you go, it will be for the same reason.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: You are one line in a very long text.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: There was no malice in his tone. That made it harder, not easier.

panels.description: Two-shot. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) at frame left, risen, arms folded. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right, turning back from the shelf to face him, quiet.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: Does it not trouble you, to think of people as lines on leaves?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Sometimes. Then I walk in the market. I eat at Padmini's hearth.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: That keeps me from becoming what you fear. Or so I hope.

panels.description: Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right, composed, facing the other man, who is off-panel at frame left. **Inset, lower right:** tight on Ramayyan's smile, a sad twist. For the first time the weariness shows in the lines around his eyes, lit by the high window.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: You are disturbed. That is good. Men who are comfortable being watched are either fools or tyrants.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI (off)
copy.text: And you? Which are you?

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN (in the inset)
copy.text: I am tired. And determined. That is all.

panels.description: The rain has thinned to drizzle; the light through the high window is soft and pale. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) at the door at frame left, as if ready to leave, looking back. Ramayyan (thin face, receding hairline, plain white cloth, no chain) small at frame right among his shelves.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: Why show me this? You could have sent me away.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Because you walk with half your weight in the north and half here.

panels.description: Two-shot, close and level. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) at frame left, stepping back from the door into the lamplight to square up to him. Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right, unmoved.

copy.speaker: NAGOJI
copy.text: I married into Velinadu. I sent my brother the final gold. I am here.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: Marriages end. Gold runs out. Roots are harder to kill than branches.

panels.description: Tight on Ramayyan (thin face, sharp fine features, receding hairline, plain white cloth, no chain) at frame right. His eyes have dropped to the Goa brand on Nagoji's bare left wrist, just in frame at the lower left edge: wrist and hand only, the edge of a cream shoulder cloth, no face.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: You are not just a man who trains horses. You are a potential message. A symbol. A warning.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: It is better you see how I measure that than imagine monsters where there are only old men with styluses.

panels.description: Ramayyan (thin face, receding hairline, plain white cloth, ink-stained fingers, no chain) at frame right with his back to Nagoji, one palm flat against the bundles on a shelf, as if feeling for a pulse in them. Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat) soft in the background at frame left.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: I have already seen three serious attempts to cut the king's life short.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: We caught those because someone, somewhere in these leaves, had written a warning in time.

copy.speaker: RAMAYYAN
copy.text: I would rather fill shelves than graves.

panels.description: Full width, bottom, bleeding in from the edge with stain-edged borders and a warm lamp palette. Dusk on the inner stones at Padmanabhapuram. Marthanda Varma (V13 varma-v1 face), younger than at the dedication, dark hair bound back, forehead bare of any crown, bare-chested in a plain mundu, sweeping the stones with a broom. Women set rows of oil-lamp flames along the walls; priests chant in the far background, small, faces not featured. A crowd presses close in a restless ring, every head and shoulder bent in reverence. Two steps from the king, one lean man in a plain mundu with a dark cloth knotted over one shoulder stands straight, isolated in silhouette against the bowed backs. The narrator is not in frame.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: I remembered that festival night.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: I saw him not by his face.

panels.description: Flashback, with the same stain-edged borders and warm lamp palette as 11.5. Tight and fast, one action only. The upright man's knife hand drives toward the edge of the king's bare side at frame right; no face on either man. The defender is seen only as a bare left forearm and hand with the Goa brand, entering from the frame edge and clamping the assassin's knife wrist; no face, no torso.

Flashback, same borders and palette. High and distant, aftermath. Broken clay pots, scattered flowers, spilled oil catching the lamplight, a dropped knife on the stones. Two still forms lie covered with temple cloth. Nair palace guards (forward topknots, bare-chested, white mundu hitched short, curved swords and round shields, no turbans) kneel around Marthanda Varma (same younger look as 11.5), who sits up with a hand to his head, an oil smear under his heel, the broom lying in the spilled oil. At the crowd's edge a gap is closing as a third man's back vanishes into the press. The narrator is not in frame.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: We never learned whether the third man carried Dutch coin, Kochi promises, or only the old houses' grudges in his sleeve.

panels.description: Night, the present, with clean borders again. The estate courtyard, the ground dried. Nagoji alone (ch21 look: topknot, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no bandages, no coat), lying on his back on the stone platform under the jackfruit tree, eyes open. A drop of rainwater hangs from a leaf above him. Open night sky above for the captions.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: That night, after the ground had dried, I thought of Ramayyan's books.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: Of my line in them. Of Revathi's. Of Padmini's. Of Lannoy's. Of the king's own.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: Historians might call Ramayyan wise, or a spider. Without men like him, kings like Marthanda Varma would stand even less chance.

panels.description: Split panel, two matched halves, hands only, no faces. Left: an exact recomposition of chapter 1 panel 1.2, a Portuguese clerk's hand in a dark cuff, a quill, a bound paper ledger lying flat and square to camera, wet ink, cold grey light, one empty ruled line left for the entry. Right: the same angle and framing, Ramayyan's ink-stained fingers, a stylus, a palm leaf flat and square to camera with one empty band, warm lamp light.

copy.speaker: LEDGER (lettered on the left page)
copy.text: 17   prisioneiro marata

copy.speaker: LEAF (lettered on the right leaf)
copy.text: Sawant, Nagoji.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: In Goa, I had been a prisoner number. Here, I was a sentence in a longer story.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: It was a small difference. It was also vast.

panels.description: Full width, bottom. Pull back high over the courtyard: the jackfruit tree, Nagoji (ch21 look: topknot, cream mundu and shoulder cloth, silver chain; no knife, no coat) small on the stone, the estate dark. Overhead the sky has cleared to stars, but on the far horizon, beyond the palms toward the sea, a new bank of cloud glows with silent lightning.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: We all kept our own accounts, in our own ways.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: Mine were carved in memories of hooves on sand and the weight of men's trust.

copy.speaker: CAPTION
copy.text: His were written in palm leaves and tags.

copy.speaker: CAPTION (separate, weighted)
copy.text: Both, I suspected, would matter when the next storm came.
